edges.reason: transfer forwards msg.sender as the source of the transferFrom call.
transfer calls transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
transferFrom calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) before mutating balances.
ensure calls pairFor with the Uniswap factory and WETH addresses.
ensure calls condition(_from,_value) when the address is not whitelisted.
msg.sender is compared with _from and indexes allowance[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before the arbitrary call.
init requires msg.sender == owner before changing sale limits.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before mass distribution.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before changing tradeAddress.
constructor sets owner = msg.sender and grants it the whole supply.
delegate performs an arbitrary delegatecall to a with calldata b.
delegatecall executes attacker code in this contract's context and can re-enter transferFrom.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value is executed without SafeMath.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value are unchecked.
total = _value * _tos.length can overflow before the balance check.
token*(10**uint256(decimals)) is an unchecked multiplication.
transferFrom mutates the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowance mapping.
approve writes directly into the allowance mapping.
batchSend updates balanceOf for sender and recipients.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after each transfer.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition compares _value against _minSale.
condition compares _value against _maxSale.
condition reads _saleNum to gate sells per address.
init assigns _minSale.
init assigns _maxSale.
init assigns _saleNum.

ensure compares _from/_to against owner.
ensure compares _from against tradeAddress.

constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
constructor sets totalSupply from _supply.
constructor mints the entire supply to msg.sender in balanceOf.
constructor gives the UNI router an infinite allowance.

addr is only consumed by setTradeAddress.
